answer_1.quote: Data-to-text (D2T) systems are attracting considerable interest due to their ability to automate the time-consuming writing of data-driven reports.

answer_2.quote: Word-overlap metrics such as (Sacre)BLEU and ROUGE have been shown to perform poorly in evaluation of natural language generation , and thus we report them here only for completeness. Conversely, contextual embedding based metrics BERTScore , BLEURT , and MoverScore-2 correlate with human judgment on sentence-level and system-level evaluation.

answer_4.quote: To confirm these findings, human evaluation is performed for Section 1 of the test set by two annotators.
answer_4.guideline: a survey which includes adequacy (estimate of overall quality), presence of hallucinations, entity inclusion, and fluency
